name: data-guard
description: Asks before a git commit or git add takes in large files, data files, personal-looking table columns or Jupyter notebooks with outputs. Only names are ever shown, never file contents.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Master switch. /data-guard off or /data-guard on switches it in a session (remembered).

maxFileMb.title: Large file limit (MB)
maxFileMb.description: A file bigger than this is flagged.

checkNotebooks.title: Check notebooks
checkNotebooks.description: Flag .ipynb files that still hold outputs or execution counts, and offer to strip them.

checkColumns.title: Check table columns
checkColumns.description: Flag csv/tsv files whose first line has column names that look like personal data (names only are ever shown).
